versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Twitter profile tweets scraping skill:

- Extracts tweets, reply threads, and engagement metrics from any public Twitter/X profile using Apify’s apidojo/twitter-profile-scraper.
- Supports filtering by username(s), tweet date range, image-only tweets, or minimum reply count.
- Returns detailed tweet data: text, engagement stats (likes, retweets, replies, etc.), author info, and tweet URLs.
- Can fetch replies, retweets, and extended profile details if specified.
- Clear instructions for running via Apify-compatible scripts or API, with CSV/JSON export options.
- Handles private, suspended, or highly active accounts gracefully with helpful usage notes.
